decisions.id: W49-3 no seat in the frame: the first seat beside it moved inward
decisions.summary: placer.place: when no candidate out to the hug lies inside the frame, the first seat beside the subject is shifted by the least that brings it inside the frame (moved_inward)
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE CONFIRMED CORRECTED: the past-the-frame seat is gone; wherever the frame can hold the caption on an axis the caption lands inside it, so 0242's 'A place that would run off the edge of the picture is never taken' and 'never left off' both hold, which is the page's purpose ('A clipped caption cannot be read'). The moved place is not one of 0242's ordered places (none of which can be taken here), so it does not narrow 'the place that covers the least'; it stays closer to the subject than a leader past the hug would, and its claim is labeled UNRESEARCHED rather than cited to 0241 as round 1 asked. Round 1 named searching past the hug as one legitimate route, not the only one; the inward move reaches the same end (never clipped where the frame can hold it).

decisions.id: W49-3a frame narrower than the caption: centered, clipped
decisions.summary: on an axis the frame is narrower than the caption, moved_inward centers it on the frame
decisions.why: The one case round 1 named as physically impossible: no place of the caption's size fits inside a frame narrower than it, so 'never clipped' cannot be honored and 'never left off' still is. Labeled in the claim (UNRESEARCHED, 'centered where the frame is narrower') and pinned by test_the_frame_is_never_left's 10 x 10 frame and the new unit test.

decisions.id: W49-4 tests restated to the page
decisions.summary: the six key-pinning tests restated; test_the_frame_is_never_left; new test_a_seat_past_the_frame_is_moved_inward_until_it_fits
decisions.why: Round 1's exception CONFIRMED CORRECTED: test_the_frame_is_never_left keeps its meaning (a 510-wide frame takes 'left', not a seat leaving it; only the 10 x 10 impossible frame reaches the fallback, now centered), and the new test pins both branches of moved_inward. Tests that enforce the request serve it.
